notes.en:
• Prevent account profile sync from failing when credentials renew concurrently.
• Keep Refresh available after an authorized sign-in encounters a sync failure, with more specific error guidance.
• Preserve complete model IDs while safely handling long optional aliases. Existing API providers, local conversations, permissions and manual installation remain. This does not guarantee that sessions can never expire.
notes.zh-CN:
• 修复账号资料同步与凭据续期并发时可能导致账号暂不可用的问题。
• 授权后同步失败时保留刷新入口，并提供更具体的错误提示。
• 保留完整模型 ID，安全处理过长别名，继续保留原有 API 配置、本地会话、权限设置和手动安装方式；并不代表账号永远不会过期。
